decisions.reason: As a low-risk, complementary care product for the installed base of wood floors, it supports the firm's system offering and customer retention.
Maintenance oil fits naturally with the firm's core wooden-floor business and gives recurring after-sales revenue with limited strategic risk.
A care line for oiled wood floors strengthens the full lifecycle proposition for existing customers, even if it overlaps somewhat with other maintenance products.
An underlay with moisture protection is a practical attachment sale that complements floor installation and aligns well with professional trade demand.
High-density underlay foam extends the installation system around the firm's flooring products and is likely worth keeping in a growing market.
The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's core competence and brand position, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it after such a recent launch.
